name: Vibe Code
author: daddybannk
queryHints:
One row holds one property. Two
ANDs on the same row match nothing.

Join employees to itself on emp_no,
one alias for each property.

Name every emp_property in the
WHERE, then its value beside it.

Five aliases: two to read the name,
three to carry the clues.
caseHints:
Only employees survived. All three
facts you need are in it.

Department IT. Role Junior. And he
started the day before the crash.

The log is stamped 9 October and he
calls it his second day.

Junior is a role in the system.
The intern is not the junior.
